summary: The discrete residue-class simplex extractions, the intrinsic-lattice lift, the parity-layer estimate, and the resulting mixed-integer depth constants are all proved with the required quantifiers and boundary cases. The graph count in the full-rank adaptive case is valid, both rank-zero branches are covered, the predecessor facts apply exactly as used, and the strict inequalities follow from W > 0, B_d < 2, and gamma_d > 1/e.
